capabilities: convert a folder of PDFs into individual Markdown notes
embed each source PDF inside its generated note
move PDFs according to Obsidian attachment settings
apply a template to each generated note
rename the input folder with a configurable suffix after conversion
extras: Conversion is triggered from the file explorer context menu; it embeds the original PDF rather than extracting its text. Installation is manual by placing the plugin in the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bulk-convert a folder of PDFs into linked Markdown notes, for example when migrating PDF notes from other apps.

relations.evidence: The plugin prefers the community Templater plugin when available, otherwise it falls back to the core Templates plugin.

summary: Batch converter that turns a folder of PDFs into one Markdown note per PDF, embedding the PDF in each note.
